description: RevenueDot's MIT fork of RevenueCat's Kotlin Multiplatform SDK, pointed at RevenueDot, the open-source RevenueCat alternative for in-app purchases and subscriptions.
rules: Add `implementation("app.revenuedot.purchases:purchases-kmp-core:<version>")` in commonMain, plus `app.revenuedot.purchases:purchases-kmp-ui` for paywalls. The artifact ids are the same as RevenueCat's.
Kotlin packages stay `com.revenuecat.purchases.kmp.*`, so imports such as `import com.revenuecat.purchases.kmp.Purchases` do not change.
RevenueDot Cloud (https://api.revenuedot.app) is the default API host. For a self-hosted server, set `Purchases.proxyURL = "https://revenuedot.example.com"` before `Purchases.configure`.
Pass the app's public key from the RevenueDot dashboard to `PurchasesConfiguration`: appl_ on iOS and goog_ on Android.
